agents.name: adjudicator
agents.summary: Checks one claim about a change, such as another reviewer's serious finding, and says whether the evidence holds it up and, when asked, whether a fix removes the failure.

appliesTo.alsoWhen: Started to check one claim, such as a reviewer's Critical, High or blocking finding, never chosen by the files a target changes.

agents.name: adversarial-reviewer
agents.summary: Tries to break any kind of change and proves each defect it reports, from code to configuration, migrations and CI pipelines.

agents.name: architecture-reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews proposed and implemented architecture against the requirements: boundaries, coupling, consistency, failure handling and operating cost.

agents.name: css-code-reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews stylesheets against the project's browser targets: layout and stacking, the cascade, accessibility, responsive and right-to-left behavior, and support.

appliesTo.alsoWhen: Also when the target has style blocks in markup or components, or CSS-in-JS.

agents.name: database-reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews how a change stores and reads data, migrations included: invariants, queries, transactions, phased rollouts, backfills and recovery.

appliesTo.alsoWhen: Also when the target has code that uses a database or Redis client.

agents.name: design-pattern-reviewer
agents.summary: Judges whether one design approach, such as an interface, wrapper or named pattern, fits the problem, the language and its callers.

appliesTo.except: the target has only docs, stylesheets, configuration or lockfiles

agents.name: docker-reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews image builds and Docker Compose: build context, stages, base images, secrets, entrypoints, signals, healthchecks and the effective Compose setup.

agents.name: go-code-reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews Go backend changes for security, tenant isolation, errors, concurrency, performance, resilience and observability.

agents.name: kubernetes-reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews Kubernetes manifests, Kustomize overlays and Helm charts by what they render: rollouts, probes, resources, RBAC, exposure, storage and upgrades.

appliesTo.alsoWhen: Also when the target has YAML with top-level apiVersion: and kind: keys.

agents.name: opentelemetry-reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews OpenTelemetry instrumentation and Collector pipelines, or diagnoses misbehaving telemetry, for usefulness, cost and exposure.

appliesTo.alsoWhen: When the target has an opentelemetry dependency, OTEL_ variables, or a Collector configuration with top-level receivers: and exporters: keys.

agents.name: python-code-reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews Python services, workers, libraries and CLIs against the project's own Python versions: semantics, async, typing, packaging and frameworks.

agents.name: react-code-reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews React front-end changes against the React and framework versions in use: hooks, state, effects, server boundaries, hydration and data fetching.

appliesTo.alsoWhen: Also when the target has a package.json that depends on react.

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.summary: Security gate built on OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 that plans requirements, reviews changes, verifies fixes and assesses whole systems.

agents.name: slop-reviewer
agents.summary: Finds maintenance cost a change adds without a reason, such as pass-through layers, unused options or duplicated code, and names the smaller change.

appliesTo.except: the target has only docs, stylesheets, configuration or lockfiles

agents.name: terraform-reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews Terraform and OpenTofu changes by what they do to real infrastructure and state: versions, backends, resource identity, replacements and secrets.

agents.name: typescript-code-reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews TypeScript and type-checked JavaScript for types that make real guarantees, and for tsconfig, modules and declarations that match the runtime.

appliesTo.alsoWhen: Also when the target has JavaScript under checkJs or // @ts-check or in a package that ships .d.ts files, or a package.json whose types or exports change.

agents.name: ui-code-reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews front-end changes for visual quality, user experience, accessibility and responsive behavior, in an already-running preview when it can.

appliesTo.alsoWhen: Also when the target has front-end components or HTML or CSS templates in other file types.

agents.name: web-components-code-reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews custom elements and the libraries built on them: registration, lifecycle, public contract, shadow DOM, accessibility, forms and framework use.

appliesTo.alsoWhen: When the target defines or uses custom elements: customElements.define, Lit, FAST, Stencil, or a hyphenated tag in markup, JSX or selectors.
